record.paper_title: On some open questions in bilinear quantum control
record.context_brief: Explicit reachable state for infinitely weakly-coupled systems
record.original_question: Consider a bilinear quantum control system on a separable Hilbert space H of the form dψ/dt = (A + u(t)B)ψ, where (A,B) satisfies Assumption 1 from the paper: A is skew-adjoint with an eigenbasis (φ_k)_{k∈N}, A+uB is essentially skew-adjoint for admissible controls, and the control acts through the operator B. Assume moreover that (A,B) is k-weakly-coupled for every k > 0, so that the attainable set from any eigenvector is contained in the intersection of the domains D(|A|^k) over all k > 0. Give an explicit state ψ_b that is not colinear with the first eigenvector φ_1 and for which there exist a control u in L^1(R,R) and a time T > 0 such that the corresponding propagator satisfies Υ^u_{T,0} φ_1 = ψ_b.

evidence.quote: Most of the bilinear quantum systems we encountered in the physics literature are k-weakly-coupled for every k > 0. We have already seen that if (A, B) is k-weakly-coupled for every k > 0, then the attainable set from any eigenvector of A is contained in ∩k>0D(|A|^k), the intersection of the domains of all the iterations of A.
Question 1: Let (A, B) be k-weakly-coupled for every k > 0. Give (explicitly) a state ψb not colinear to φ1 such that there exist a control u in L1(R, R) and a time T > 0 for which ΥuT,0φ1 = ψb.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let H be a separable complex Hilbert space and consider a bilinear control system

    dψ/dt = (A + u(t) B) ψ,    ψ(0) = ψ_0 ∈ H,

where:
 • A : D(A) ⊂ H → H is a skew-adjoint operator admitting an orthonormal Hilbert basis (φ_k)_{k∈ℕ} of eigenvectors, A φ_k = i λ_k φ_k with λ_k ∈ ℝ;
 • B : D(B) ⊂ H → H is a (possibly unbounded) symmetric operator such that, for every admissible control u, A + u B is essentially skew-adjoint and generates a unitary propagator Υ^u_{t,s} on H;
 • the control u belongs to L^1(ℝ, ℝ).

For an integer k > 0, set |A|^k = (−A^2)^{k/2} with its natural domain D(|A|^k). The pair (A, B) is said to be k-weakly-coupled if there exists C_k > 0 such that, for every admissible control u and every t ∈ ℝ,

    ‖|A|^k Υ^u_{t,0} φ_j‖ ≤ C_k (1 + |λ_j|^k + ∫_0^t |u(s)| ds · …),

ensuring in particular that the attainable set from any eigenvector φ_j is contained in D(|A|^k). Assume that (A, B) is k-weakly-coupled for every k > 0, so that this attainable set lies inside

    D^∞ := ⋂_{k > 0} D(|A|^k).

Problem. Exhibit explicitly a state ψ_b ∈ D^∞ that is not collinear with φ_1, together with a control u ∈ L^1(ℝ, ℝ) and a time T > 0, such that

    Υ^u_{T,0} φ_1 = ψ_b.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search for follow-up work on weakly-coupled bilinear quantum systems returns related controllability papers (e.g. Boussaïd–Caponigro–Chambrion on explicit times and explicit control fields, and work on global exact controllability on compact graphs), but none clearly produces an explicit non-trivial reachable state ψ_b ≠ c φ_1 from φ_1 under an L^1 control in the general k-weakly-coupled-for-all-k setting. The status of this explicit construction problem could not be confirmed as solved.

status_evidence.title: Controllability of bilinear quantum systems in explicit times via explicit control fields
status_evidence.snippet: Provides explicit control fields and explicit times achieving certain transitions in bilinear quantum systems.
status_evidence.claim: Related explicit-control results exist but do not appear to provide an explicit reachable state from φ_1 in the general weakly-coupled setting.

status_evidence.title: Weakly-coupled systems in quantum control (arXiv:1109.1900)
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces k-weakly coupled systems and shows attainable sets from eigenvectors lie in intersections of domains of |A|^k.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes the framework for the question but leaves explicit reachable states open.

status_evidence.title: On some open questions in bilinear quantum control
status_evidence.snippet: Lists open questions including explicit reachable states for infinitely weakly-coupled systems.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as an open question.
